workGuides.serviceName: PAN Card Registration (NSDL CSC Biometric / OTP Flow)
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (Mobile linked or applicant physically present for fingerprint)
Signature of applicant (Clear blue or black ink on plain paper)

steps.title: Login & Form Type Selection
steps.description: Login to Digital Seva Kendra with VLE credentials -> Click PAN Card Services -> Select NSDL Paperless e-KYC.
checklist: Check CSC wallet balance has minimum ₹107
Select Form 49A for Indian citizen
Select Physical & e-PAN option

steps.title: Enter Aadhaar & Applicant Demographics
steps.description: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar number. Name, Father Name and Date of Birth must match Aadhaar exactly.
checklist: Confirm spelling letter by letter
Select Father Name as name to appear on card
Enter applicant mobile number

steps.title: Biometric / OTP Verification
steps.description: Click e-KYC -> Ask customer to enter OTP or place index finger on biometric reader.
checklist: Green light on biometric scanner
Ensure Aadhaar photo preview loads clearly

steps.title: Payment & Acknowledgment Generation
steps.description: Authorize CSC Wallet PIN. Official fee ₹107 deducted. Print 15-digit acknowledgment slip.
checklist: Hand over acknowledgment slip to customer
Note acknowledgment number in Request internal notes

importantNotes: Do not submit nickname or short initial in father name column.
If Aadhaar name does not match 10th certificate, inform customer prior to submission.
Physical PAN arrives within 7–10 days at customer address by speed post.

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of Applicant & Family Head
Salary Certificate / ITR / Bank Statement (Last 6 months)
Latest Delhi Electricity Bill or Water Bill (Must be less than 3 months old)

steps.title: Citizen Registration / Login
steps.description: Open edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in -> Citizen Login -> Enter User ID and password or Aadhaar OTP.
checklist: Verify applicant profile details match Aadhaar
Select Revenue Department -> Issuance of Income Certificate

steps.title: Family Income & Occupations Entry
steps.description: Fill annual income accurately. Include earnings of spouse and earning dependents.
checklist: Enter purpose of certificate (e.g. EWS admission, scholarship, ration)
Enter local address in Burari / Delhi subdivision

steps.title: Document Upload & Size Verification
steps.description: Scan and upload PDF documents. Every PDF must be strictly below 100 KB with 150 DPI greyscale.
checklist: Photo must be under 50KB JPG
Affidavit scanned clearly with notary stamp visible
Address proof bill matches residential address

steps.title: Submission & Application Tracking
steps.description: Submit form and generate Application Tracking Number. SDM Burari inspection timeline is 14 days.
checklist: Give printed receipt to customer with tracking number
Update work status to Under Process

importantNotes: Warning: Electricity bill older than 90 days results in instant rejection by SDM desk.
Never upload encrypted or password protected PDFs.

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card with mobile linked for contactless Aadhaar test
Class 10 marksheet or birth certificate for age verification (Minimum 18 yrs for LMV / Gear bike)
Medical self-declaration Form 1 (or Form 1A if age > 40)
Passport size photo and signature scan

steps.title: State & Authority Selection
steps.description: Select State -> Delhi -> Select Burari RTO / Contactless Online Aadhaar Flow.
checklist: Select MCWG (Motor Cycle with Gear) and LMV (Car) as required
Check mobile OTP authentication

steps.title: Upload Documents & Fee Payment
steps.description: Upload ID proof and age proof. Pay government fee ₹350 via Parivahan payment gateway.
checklist: Save fee payment receipt with transaction ID
Print road safety tutorial acknowledgment

steps.title: Online LL Traffic Test / Slot
steps.description: Customer watches mandatory 15-minute road safety video online and completes 10 traffic questions.
checklist: Score minimum 6/10 marks to pass
Download digital Learner Licence PDF immediately

importantNotes: Learner Licence is valid across India for 6 months.
Permanent Driving Licence slot can be booked after 30 days from LL issue date.
